sources: IFCT 2017 – Indian Food Composition Tables (NIN, Hyderabad)
Kaggle – Ayurvedic Indian Food Properties Dataset
meta.servingUnit: nutrition values per 100 g; serving fields describe suggested portions
dataNotes: Food IDs are unique and stable; food counts are derived from the foods array.
Nutrition values are demonstration estimates and are not traced to a source per food record. Review against a primary food composition source before clinical or production use.
Ayurvedic properties are qualitative sample labels and require practitioner review before being used for personalized recommendations.
Serving amounts in ml are volume measures; applications that calculate nutrients from per-100-g values should convert volume to mass before scaling.
